messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: release v2025.03.12 -> prod-eu at 1951234567. Post-deploy smokechecks: 1 failing probe (kv-prefix-ttl-eu). Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/1951234567/kv-ttl

Maya Chen: seeing kv TTL probe failing ~15% of requests, starts ~2m after rollout. quick check queued. :eyes:

Anita K: @Maya can you paste the probe payload? are these 504s or 200+stale?

Maya Chen: payload looks like 200 but body shows miss + negative ttl:
```
{"key":"user:12345","status":"miss","ttl":-1}
```
probable TTL expiry computed as negative after the model bump.

Ravi S: that matches a TTL sign bug -- we changed epoch handling in v2025.03.12 PR#998. Can we avoid a full rollback and instead pin routing for kv-cache in eu to v2025.03.11?

Luke W: full rollback during the change window is disruptive. Prefer routing pin for /services/kv-cache -> v2025.03.11 for prod-eu, then run targeted smoke.

Maya Chen: on it, updating release routing config to pin kv-cache in eu and re-running smoke (expect ~90s).

Maya Chen: smoke run command:
```
curl -sS -H "x-release-test: true" https://smoke-eu.redwood.internal/kv-probe | jq .
```
=> after pin: 200 ok, miss rate <1% for 300 requests.

deploy-bot: Route update succeeded. Pin applied: prod-eu/kv-cache -> v2025.03.11. Post-pin smoke pass confirmed. :thumbsup:

Anita K: we'll open a hotfix branch to revert the TTL epoch change and add unit tests for negative ttl. Target: merge + canary redeploy only for kv-cache next change window.

Ravi S: pinging SRE oncall to watch kv_ttl_negative and synthetic_kv_miss_rate for 30m @oncall-sre

eng-oncall-bot: Alert subscription updated; SRE oncall notified for metrics: kv_ttl_negative, synthetic_kv_miss_rate. :bell:

Maya Chen: updating release notes and changelog: added section "prod-eu: kv-cache pinned to v2025.03.11 due to TTL calc regression; hotfix in progress". Also adding regression test to smoke suite.

Luke W: optional: temporarily relax synthetic miss threshold to 5% for EU for 10m while monitoring to avoid noisy alerts. If applied, capture timestamp and revert after 10m.

Anita K: agreed. I'll apply threshold flag and document the change in the deploy ticket.

Maya Chen: will follow up with the hotfix PR link and schedule a focused canary once merged. Closing this thread; will reopen if metrics drift.
